name: Shokushu Makai no Ryoshuu ~Kairaku to Kutsuu ni Ochita Madoushi Selfis no Kutsujoku
original_name: 触手魔界の虜囚～快楽と苦痛に堕ちた魔導士セルフィスの屈辱
source:
The Kingdom of Lanrod was a small country with rich resources.
It was established a long time ago to seal off the evil god with the courtesy of the goddess Elixia and to maintain it.
However, now that it became a legend, and a lustful wizard destroyed the royal seal with vicious intention, which resulted in the collapse of the kingdom itself.
Luckily, the evil god has yet to revive. The remaining seal of the goddess are shattered and kept in some brave men's body of the destroyed kingdom.

Cool and beautiful Selphis was a hero among them. She faces off against Zodiac, possessed by the evil god!
Long ago she had provoked Zodiac in a hand-to-hand battle. But things are different now.
This isn't Zodiac, but an unspeakable horror from another realm...!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax-touch/work/=/product_id/RJ097715.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
兰罗德王国是一个资源丰富的小国。
它是很久以前为了以女神艾丽克西娅的礼遇封印邪神并维持它而设立的。
然而，现在它已经成为了传说，一个好色的巫师恶意破坏了王印，导致王国本身崩溃。
幸运的是，邪神还没有复活。女神剩余的封印被打破，并保存在被毁灭的王国的一些勇敢者的体内。

又酷又美丽的塞尔菲斯就是其中的英雄。她与邪神附身的十二宫展开对决！
之前她曾在一场肉搏战中激怒了十二宫。但现在情况不同了。
这不是十二宫，而是来自异界的难以言喻的恐怖……！
